purpose: Test whether V108's outcome-blind critical-service substitutions were directionally unstable because the fixed 100-frame causal-shock latch kept changing placements long after the instantaneous 3/2 arrival-rate certificate ceased to hold.

v108_mechanism_diagnosis.activation_shape: For each seed the single spike was active for 151 frames, sustained burst for 153-154 frames, and four-pulse burst for 598-599 frames, while the instantaneous 3/2 certificate held for only 52, 54-55, and 202-203 frames respectively.
v108_mechanism_diagnosis.service10_outcome: The 9/10 arm passed all three paired gates for sustained3x200ms and both QPR gates for spike5x50ms, but failed spike throughput mean by 0.325%, and failed pulse direction because only one of three seeds improved despite positive means.
v108_mechanism_diagnosis.service20_outcome: The stricter 4/5 arm reduced intervention but degraded all three pulse throughput seeds and did not improve cross-scenario consistency.
v108_mechanism_diagnosis.interpretation: The critical-service axis is active and partially effective, while stricter proxy magnitude is not the missing certificate. The next independent axis is temporal support of the already certified intervention. Shorter result-blind latches directly reduce post-shock and repeated-pulse exposure without using scenario labels or outcomes.

frozen_parent_profiles.V108_service_certificate: maximum candidate-to-anchor service proxy ratio 9/10 with every V108 locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, critical-frontier, and exact-noncritical-anchor certificate unchanged

closed_axes.critical_service_ratio_refitting: 9/10 and 4/5 tested in V108; V109 fixes 9/10
closed_axes.arrival_rate_threshold_refitting: 3/2 and 2/1 tested in V107; V109 fixes 3/2

hypothesis.primary: V108's certified critical-service move is useful near a detected arrival-rate edge, but a 100-frame latch over-applies it after the current 3/2 certificate disappears and compounds the perturbation across repeated pulses.
hypothesis.arm_a: Retain the exact V108 9/10 critical-service mechanism and reduce only the causal activation horizon from 100 to 25 frames.
hypothesis.arm_b: Retain the exact V108 9/10 critical-service mechanism and reduce only the causal activation horizon from 100 to 50 frames.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if neither candidate passes every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E896-E898 cohort.

allowed: the exact V108 80-frame baseline and 20-frame recent first-seen ReqId history
the current frame and an outcome-blind activation deadline derived only from current or prior exact 3/2 detections
every immutable and current-state V108 critical-service, locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and frontier input
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request outcome
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, or registered burst interval as a routing input
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.arrival_definition: Exactly the frozen V107/V108 first-seen ReqId definition.
information_boundary.shock_definition: Exactly the frozen 80-frame baseline plus 20-frame recent window, minimum 20 requests in each, and exact 3/2 integer-rate comparison.
information_boundary.activation_definition: On each exact threshold detection, set or extend the deadline to current_frame + horizon - 1. Arm A horizon=25 and arm B horizon=50. No scenario-specific reset, episode budget, outcome input, or retrospective classification is allowed.
information_boundary.service_time_proxy_and_certificates: Bit-for-bit V108 9/10 semantics; only the activation horizon differs.

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: causal activation horizon: 25 or 50 frames instead of V108's 100
candidate_mechanism.eligible_players_and_certificates: Exactly V108 service10: tied maximum remaining-critical-path frontier players only, exact noncritical V94 anchor, 9/10 individual proxy, warm/parent/child locality and CPU/memory headroom noninferiority, routed-score noninferiority, then strictly lower complete critical proxy plus nonworse routed, OCS, immutable-baseline welfare and V94 coordination guards.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without sufficient history, an active horizon, or a certified critical substitution, dispatch exact V94 for identical current state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V108 causal-arrival and critical-service fields
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain, then minimum relative throughput change, then prefer the shorter 25-frame intervention, then arm_id
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select a V109 profile
